title: To designate a segment of Interstate Route 35 in the State of Minnesota as the "James L. Oberstar Memorial Highway".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was reported to the House on November 12, 2014. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the segment of Interstate Route 35 between milepost 133 at Forest Lake, Minnesota, and milepost 259 at Duluth, Minnesota, as the "James L. Oberstar Memorial Highway."

summary.headline: Names a stretch of Interstate 35 in Minnesota the "James L. Oberstar Memorial Highway" in honor of the former congressman.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a name to the part of Interstate 35 in Minnesota that runs from milepost 133 at Forest Lake to milepost 259 at Duluth. The road keeps its interstate number and route, and the law changes no rules about travel or construction. The name honors James L. Oberstar, a former U.S. Representative from Minnesota.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2014.
